facts.text: Serve the mains when Frank turns up at his brother's Christmas dinner.
facts.why: Frank never turns up at James's Christmas dinner. He turns down James's invitation every year and sends impersonal gifts. The Ghost of Christmas Present only shows him James celebrating and missing him.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when the Ghost shows Frank his brother's Christmas dinner.

facts.text: Serve the mains when Frank turns up at his brother's Christmas dinner.
facts.why: Same cue as printed on the card. Frank watches James's Christmas through the ghost's vision. He does not arrive at it.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when the Ghost shows Frank his brother's Christmas dinner.

facts.why: Lew Hayward is Frank's dead mentor, who appears as a decomposing ghost to warn him about the three spirits. Preston Rhinelander is the network chairman.

facts.text: Pull up a chair. The network can wait, there's a hot dinner on and seconds for everyone.
facts.why: Frank never says this. It is printed in quote marks as a character line, so it counts as a quote. The Frank lines on the opened quote page include nothing about pulling up a chair or seconds. His real Christmas Eve broadcast line is 'It's the one night of the year when we all act a little nicer'.
facts.fix: It's the one night of the year when we all act a little nicer.

fix_note.text: It's the one night of the year when we all act a little nicer.

facts.text: Frank's drink, before three ghosts drop in.
facts.why: Frank pours himself a drink (the Bacardi) in the scene where Lew Hayward's ghost warns him three ghosts are coming, so the line holds.
facts.fix: Hot toddy with lemon: Warm up before the ghosts turn up.
